source.provenance: Biblical Hebrew, the Masoretic text with points and cantillation. The verse wording is the MAM text as the Biblia app (C:/Users/CJWal/dev/biblia-v0, scripts/build-tanakh.mjs) fetched it from the Sefaria API on 2026-09-20; copied from that build on 2026-10-18, nothing retyped. NOT yet byte-compared here against Hebrew Wikisource or Sefaria by scripts/verify-scripture.mjs; until that check is recorded the text stays unpublished. There is no open-licence Hebrew New Testament at hand, so this language's scripture seed is Genesis 1:1–5 rather than 1 John 1; the English beside it is the course authors' own rendering, drafted by an AI assistant and not a published translation.

review.notes: Wording copied from the Biblia app's build of the MAM text; a byte-comparison against the edition (scripts/verify-scripture.mjs) has not been recorded yet. The verses are Biblical Hebrew, read by the Hebrew analyser in its Biblical period (the cantillation marks decide it).

sentences.text: בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
sentences.english: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.

sentences.text: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ הָיְתָ֥ה תֹ֙הוּ֙ וָבֹ֔הוּ וְחֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃
sentences.english: And the earth was formless and empty, and darkness was over the face of the deep, and the spirit of God was hovering over the face of the waters.
And God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

sentences.text: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־הָא֖וֹר כִּי־ט֑וֹב וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֥ין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
sentences.english: And God saw the light, that it was good, and God separated the light from the darkness.

sentences.text: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים ׀ לָאוֹר֙ י֔וֹם וְלַחֹ֖שֶׁךְ קָ֣רָא לָ֑יְלָה וַֽיְהִי־עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃
sentences.english: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night; and there was evening and there was morning, one day.
